title: Vallal
desc: Durairasu is heartbroken when the girl he loves marries another man. However, when the girl and her husband die in an accident, Durairasu dedicates his life to bringing up their daughter.

title: Aavarampoo
desc: Sakkarai, a mentally challenged orphan, works for the village chief, Thevar. Trouble begins in his life when he falls in love with his master's daughter, Thamarai.

title: Priyanka
desc: A lower-caste girl striving for social change rejects an upper-caste man, triggering deadly bigotry. Later, when her father is killed, a sudden natural calamity forces society to confront its divide.

title: Adhu
desc: Meera, a young woman, is happy as she is able to see the world after she has an eye transplant done. However, her joy is short-lived, as she also sees supernatural beings not visible to others.

title: Thalattu Padava
desc: Raja, an educated young man, works as a driver for a rich client and gets harassed by his granddaughter. When she realises how learned he is, she falls in love with him and wishes to marry him.
